decision: STANDARD_WE_DEFINITION_INSUFFICIENT: target a hard-YES secure, extractable RankVM witness PRF/predictable token (or an enhanced WE notion proving the same game).

executable_toy_separation.interpretation: language membership and adversarial witness availability are different facts

challenge_game: fix one program/deposit/epoch context x whose RankVM-invalidity relation is a YES instance
run distributed setup and give the adversary the public artifact, all corrupted contributor states, abort transcripts, and erasure receipts
withhold every complete authenticated RankVM INVALID witness
challenge the adversary to distinguish F_k(x) from a uniform output or recover the committed Bitcoin fault scalar

required_guarantees.extractability: any algorithm that recovers or non-negligibly predicts the output yields a complete authenticated RankVM INVALID witness
required_guarantees.hard_YES_pseudorandomness: the fixed per-deposit output remains pseudorandom without a complete authenticated witness even though x is in the language
required_guarantees.partial_setup_corruption: the guarantees survive corruption of every contributor except one, including malicious abort/restart attempts
required_guarantees.witness_invariance: all accepting witnesses for the same context produce the identical output

required_security.standard_WE_gap: ordinary NO-instance witness-encryption secrecy alone makes no claim for this already-YES statement
